'''Cobaltia''' was a location on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. [[Tag Rogaren]] had [[tea biscuit]]s from this region, and went to get them for his guest, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] when she visited his [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Audacity]]''.<ref name="SW 9">[[Star Wars (2013) 9|''Star Wars'' (2013) 9]]</ref>
